entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adam Bajalics von Bajaháza, also Adam Bajalić von Bajaházy or Adam Bayalitsch, entered Austrian military service and fought against Prussia, Ottoman Turkey, and France. During the Italian campaign of 1796–1797 against Napoleon Bonaparte, he commanded a brigade or a division in several actions.
